title: PacBio Long Read Sequencing Protocol
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.r9xd97n
materials: The mtDNA was extracted using a DNeasy kit (Qiagen).

steps.title: Sequencing was performed using PacBio RSII...
steps.instruction: Sequencing was performed using PacBio RSII Chemistry P6-C4, 10kb template preparation and sequencing with 3.24 ug input DNA at the Ramaciotti Center at University of New South Wales (UNSW).

steps.title: PacBio long-read sequencing of the Alstonville...
steps.instruction: PacBio long-read sequencing of the Alstonville and Japan mtDNA produced 882.56 Mb of raw data.

steps.title: Read lengths averaged 5,573 bases with...
steps.instruction: Read lengths averaged 5,573 bases with longest read length of 24,822 bases and mean coverage of 40X for each mtDNA.

steps.title: Sequences were assembled using FALCON 1
steps.instruction: Sequences were assembled using FALCON 1.8.2 (Pacific Biosciences of California, Inc.) and aligned and annotated to the D. melanogaster A + T rich region using Geneious 9.1.8 (Biomatters Ltd.).
